scope: M2 backend-aware budget component and offline/simulated adapter validation only

checks.note: Includes 4 pre-existing uncommitted OAuth experiment safety tests; those experiments are not part of PR #9. The committed-tree result is separately verified after commit.

budget_rules.openlist_cache: one largest source file, conservatively retained through readback
budget_rules.direct_api_cache: no full upload copy by backend contract; real adapter still requires verification
budget_rules.temporary_caps: explicit source/upload/readback caps, including retained stage files; unknown is manual_review
budget_rules.grouping: same st_dev merges simultaneous resources before phase peak; separate devices checked independently; system root always checked
budget_rules.allocation_credit: registered physical blocks only, bounded per source/payload file; unrelated old files never credited
budget_rules.retained_batch: all sources retained plus maximum one sequential backend payload
budget_rules.readback: stream or explicit extra full-file copy

simulation_cases: batch source retention and largest cache
free space drops before next simulated write
source CLI unknown cost/insufficient space before network
outstanding_M2_acceptance: M3 actual adapter overhead bounds and real file registration
M3 stage/write checkpoints wired into actual backend lifecycle
actual upload/readback process buffering, safe-stop latency and full-run reserve verification
real M3/M4 failure gates preventing invalid-file upload/delivery
not_claimed: kernel disk quota or hard reservation
